ignoreValues.reason: False positive on this dark-first site: the static pass resolves an assumed white canvas (so it reports the site's white text as 1:1), and the live pass compares antialiased glyph-edge pixels instead of the declared foreground/background pair. Every finding it raised here was checked by rendered-pixel measurement and by a WCAG-correct audit of declared colour against the composited background, which reports zero failures across all four pages at 375/768/1280/1920.
